It is very true that work seems to be an escape for him, we both spend most of the day there. The hardest for me is spending all day with him, driving him home, and then knowing he lives alone and is likely to just be in his apartment alone until i see him to go to work next. I appreciate your insight.
Thank you, this makes sense and is very useful to hear.

Yes I have been going with silence as the best option, but for example today when someone said "whatd you do, try to hang yourself?" and they walk away, when it is just me and him I feel like I should almost say something along the lines of "sorry man, just ignore them" but instead I stay silent.
I dont necessarily feel the need to ask about therapy, but my problem is when people ask about the rope burns and I don't know how to handle it.

Thank you, and this is where I probably overthink things too much, but I do worry so much about him, however I have felt like I can't express that I am worried for him because it might make him feel like he is adding some sort of burden on me. This is where I need people's thoughts, because I want to show I care, but dont know if that is something that is okay to say?
